name: Vaultwarden
desc: Unofficial Bitwarden-compatible password manager server. Works with all Bitwarden clients.

postInstall.note: Vaultwarden is running at http://127.0.0.1:${VW_PORT}. Use a reverse proxy with HTTPS for production. Connect your Bitwarden app to this server URL.

form.label: Allow signups
form.hint: Set to false after creating your account to prevent others from registering.
